item.description:
This release adds Linux as a third supported platform, with polish and fixes for Windows and Mac.
## Cross-platform
Authenticate websocket connections via headers rather than query parameters so session tokens stop appearing in logs ([#537](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/537)), handle new error codes returned by the auth endpoint including WorkOS rate-limit responses ([#535](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/535), [#624](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/624)).
## Windows
Hide titlebar in screensaver preview ([#629](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/629), [#630](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/630)), close screensaver on mouse movement ([#615](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/615)), allow keyboard commands while in screensaver mode ([#613](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/613)), focus email field on first-time wizard open ([#644](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/644)), restrict verification-code input to 6 digits ([#637](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/637)).
## Mac
Validate the verification-code field in the settings dialog ([#627](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/627)), correct an `Error()` format-string bug and silence noisy `playing` log lines ([#315](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/315), [#646](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/646)).
## Linux
Initial Linux support ([#544](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/544)): Vulkan renderer with linear and cubic frame blending ([#626](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/626)), Lato font with drop-shadow overlay text ([#620](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/620)), mouse-cursor OSD and remote control commands ([#619](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/619)), Wayland/KWin compositor-ping handling to prevent window desaturation ([#628](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/628)), render loop paced to display FPS rather than content FPS, `--fullscreen` flag with Ctrl+Q quit, and an AppImage build replacing the legacy shell script with a Python implementation ([#621](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/621)).
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.15.0...0.16.0
